meta.bit_reading_note: every circuit has six classical bits. In the wait test (circuit W-no, W-ref; part W) c0 to c4 are the end lines' results (manacitra.wait.WAIT_TEST_ROUNDS) and c5 is M's; in the Ramsey circuits and the zero-wait baseline (part R) only M is measured, into c5 (the label's m_clbit), and the other bits read 0
meta.description: Kickoff 50, the neighbour test. Two waiting qubits M, each on its chain L1-M-L3: 144 on 143-144-145, and 143 on 144-143-142 as the control. Per M: the wait test without and with XY4 refocusing (W-no, W-ref; manacitra.wait.build_wait_test, unedited); and seven Ramsey-type circuits over the wait test's own wait T_M (2611 dt) on M: R0, a plain Ramsey with the neighbours idle in |0>; R1, the wait test with every CZ touching M replaced by a delay of the same length, so the neighbours do what they do in the wait test; R2, R0 with both neighbours put in |1> before the wait; R3, R1 with the neighbours' operations other than measure and reset replaced by delays; E0 and E1, R0 and R1 with one refocusing pulse at the middle of the wait; and Z, M's zero-wait baseline. 36 circuits (2 M x 9 circuits x 2 copies) in one random order, 5000 shots each; the sampler's own dynamical decoupling and twirling off, as IBM recorded them.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0

built_from.how: W-no and W-ref by manacitra.wait.build_wait_test at this commit, unedited, submitted as built; R0, R2 and Z written on the wait test's three lines (M into c5), translated by manacitra.wait.to_backend and scheduled by manacitra.wait.scheduled; R1, R3, E0 and E1 by the transformations in hw_50.py (source_code), applied to W-no as scheduled; against the live ibm_fez target at build (dt 4 ns)

T_M.definition: from the end of M's first H (its first sx) to the start of its last H (its last sx), in the wait test without refocusing (W-no) as scheduled by manacitra.wait.scheduled on the live target

fixed_before_the_data.rule: H50, on 144: the gap is REPRODUCED if 144's d0 interval lies entirely above reproduced_floor, otherwise the verdict carries "(Kickoff 49's gap not present today)"; SUPPORTED if Delta_active = loss(R0) - loss(R1) has its interval entirely above supported; OPPOSITE if entirely below -supported; NOT SUPPORTED if entirely inside [-not_supported_band, +not_supported_band]; NOT SETTLED otherwise. loss = M's P(1) minus its P(1) in Z; d0 = F_no - F_ref (1 - loss(R0)), d1 the same with R1
fixed_before_the_data.bootstraps: 90% intervals (5th and 95th percentiles) from one joint bootstrap (seed bootstrap, n_boot draws), in a fixed order: M by M (144, then 143): F_no, F_ref, then Z, R0, R1, R2, R3, E0, E1; for each, the wait test's F (the copies with replacement, each redrawn from a multinomial), then M's P(1) (the copies with replacement, each redrawn binomially)

hw_50.py.text:
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "site"))
import manacitra  # noqa: E402
from manacitra import wait as W  # noqa: E402

COMMIT, TAG_NAME = "a55354d0d4903d5d624c6cf946b8130d0ccc4b57", "v0.5.0"
K49_SHA = {"wait.py": "ead255a4be1d0e1ae9cffbc6d266cc70fe9a6534c685bd18e2772a1f7b69a2a8",
           "workload.py": "ad24c80ca4f6cba7f19940dd15c6cc5ec9d18ebfeba503eff225d57cd52dd02b"}   # hardware-49/inputs.json
RULE_SHA_GIVEN = "8a3228b03e89fca5a81e101f59d9d65757a74a6c06f2b0205f158770b85da039"   # the author, in chat, 13 October
CHAINS = {"144": [143, 144, 145], "143": [144, 143, 142]}
CIRCUITS = ("W-no", "W-ref", "R0", "R1", "R2", "R3", "E0", "E1", "Z")
COPIES, SHOTS = 2, 5_000
SEEDS = {"order": 5050, "bootstrap": 50, "n_boot": 10_000}
M_CLBIT = W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS - 1        # M is measured into c5 in every circuit
T_M_K49 = {"scheduled_dt": 2611, "part_b_even_dt": 2612}
CAL_K49 = "2026-10-13 16:08:33 UTC"


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def now():
    return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())


def log(msg):
    line = f"{now()} {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with (HERE / "run.log").open("a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- instructions and timelines
def instructions(c):
    """A circuit as a list of (operation, physical qubits, clbits)."""
    return [(i.operation, [c.find_bit(q).index for q in i.qubits], [c.find_bit(x).index for x in i.clbits]) for i in c.data]


def rebuild(src, ins, name):
    """A circuit with src's qubits, clbits, registers and layout record, holding these instructions."""
    out = src.copy_empty_like(name=name)
    for op, qs, cs in ins:
        out.append(op, [out.qubits[i] for i in qs], [out.clbits[j] for j in cs])
    out._layout = src.layout
    return out


def duration(op, qs, target, dt):
    nm = op.name
    if nm == "delay":
        if op.unit != "dt":
            raise RuntimeError(f"a delay in {op.unit}, not dt")
        return int(op.duration)
    if nm in ("barrier", "rz"):
        return 0
    return int(round(target[nm][tuple(qs)].duration / dt))


def timed(ins, target, dt, qubits):
    """Start times of a padded instruction list on these qubits: each qubit's instructions tile time, and every
    multi-qubit instruction (CZ, barrier) starts when all its qubits are free at the same moment. Refuses a list that
    is not padded. Returns [(index, name, qubits, clbits, start, duration)] for instructions on these qubits."""
    clock = defaultdict(int)
    out = []
    for k, (op, qs, cs) in enumerate(ins):
        if not set(qs) & set(qubits):
            continue
        d = duration(op, qs, target, dt)
        starts = {clock[q] for q in qs}
        if len(starts) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError(f"not padded at {op.name} on {qs}: clocks {sorted(starts)}")
        s = starts.pop()
        for q in qs:
            clock[q] = s + d
        out.append((k, op.name, qs, cs, s, d))
    return out


def schedule(c, backend, chain):
    """manacitra.wait.scheduled, keeping only the chain's instructions."""
    sch = W.scheduled(c, backend.target)
    return [x for x in instructions(sch) if set(x[1]) <= set(chain)], sch


def window(tl, M):
    """M's window: the end of its first sx to the start of its last sx."""
    sx = [(s, d) for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if nm == "sx" and qs == [M]]
    return {"start_dt": sx[0][0] + sx[0][1], "end_dt": sx[-1][0], "T_dt": sx[-1][0] - (sx[0][0] + sx[0][1]), "n_sx": len(sx)}


def events(tl, q, names=("measure", "reset")):
    return [{"op": nm, "start_dt": s, "duration_dt": d, "clbit": (cs[0] if cs else None)} for _, nm, qs, cs, s, d in tl if q in qs and nm in names]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the transformations
def cz_to_delays(ins, M, target, dt):
    from qiskit.circuit import Delay
    out = []
    for op, qs, cs in ins:
        if op.name == "cz" and M in qs:
            d = duration(op, qs, target, dt)
            out += [(Delay(d, unit="dt"), [q], []) for q in qs]
        else:
            out.append((op, qs, cs))
    return out


def neighbours_quiet(ins, ends, target, dt):
    from qiskit.circuit import Delay
    out = []
    for op, qs, cs in ins:
        if len(qs) == 1 and qs[0] in ends and op.name not in ("measure", "reset", "delay", "barrier"):
            if op.name not in ("rz", "sx", "x"):
                raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected {op.name} on a neighbour")
            d = duration(op, qs, target, dt)
            if d:
                out.append((Delay(d, unit="dt"), qs, []))
        else:
            out.append((op, qs, cs))
    return out


def insert_echo(ins, M, target, dt, chain):
    """One X on M at the middle of M's window, splitting the delay on M that holds it."""
    from qiskit.circuit import Delay
    from qiskit.circuit.library import XGate
    tl = timed(ins, target, dt, chain)
    w = window(tl, M)
    dx = int(round(target["x"][(M,)].duration / dt))
    p = w["start_dt"] + (w["T_dt"] - dx) // 2
    hold = [(k, s, d) for k, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if nm == "delay" and qs == [M] and s <= p and p + dx <= s + d]
    if len(hold) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("no single delay on M holds the window's middle")
    k, s, d = hold[0]
    new = [(Delay(p - s, unit="dt"), [M], [])] if p > s else []
    new.append((XGate(), [M], []))
    if s + d - p - dx > 0:
        new.append((Delay(s + d - p - dx, unit="dt"), [M], []))
    out = ins[:k] + new + ins[k + 1:]
    return out, {"x_start_dt": p, "x_duration_dt": dx, "centre_offset_dt": (p + dx / 2) - (w["start_dt"] + w["T_dt"] / 2)}


def logical(kind, T):
    """R0, R2 or Z on the wait test's three lines (L1 = 0, M = 1, L3 = 2), M measured into c5."""
    from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3, W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS, name=kind)
    if kind == "R2":
        qc.x(W.L1)
        qc.x(W.L3)
        qc.barrier()
    qc.h(W.M)
    if kind in ("R0", "R2"):
        qc.delay(T, W.M, unit="dt")
    qc.h(W.M)
    qc.measure(W.M, M_CLBIT)
    return qc


def build_chain(name, chain, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    no = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend)
    ref = W.build_wait_test(chain, True, backend)
    no_ins, _ = schedule(no, backend, chain)
    tl_no = timed(no_ins, t, dt, chain)
    w_no = window(tl_no, M)
    T = w_no["T_dt"]
    # check 3: in W-no, M's instructions between its first and last H (rz, sx, rz each) are CZs (and barriers) only
    m_ops = [nm for op, qs, _ in instructions(no) if M in qs for nm in [op.name]]
    i0, i1 = m_ops.index("sx"), len(m_ops) - 1 - m_ops[::-1].index("sx")
    between = m_ops[i0 + 1:i1]
    inner = between[1:-1] if between[:1] == ["rz"] and between[-1:] == ["rz"] else between
    check3 = {"M_ops_between_first_and_last_sx": between, "cz_only": set(inner) <= {"cz", "barrier"} and inner.count("cz") == 5}
    r1_ins = cz_to_delays(no_ins, M, t, dt)
    r3_ins = neighbours_quiet(r1_ins, (L1, L3), t, dt)
    e1_ins, e1_x = insert_echo(r1_ins, M, t, dt, chain)
    made = {}
    for kind in ("R0", "R2", "Z"):
        isa = W.to_backend(logical(kind, T), chain, backend)
        made[kind] = schedule(isa, backend, chain)[0], isa
    e0_ins, e0_x = insert_echo(made["R0"][0], M, t, dt, chain)
    circ = {"W-no": no, "W-ref": ref,
            "R0": rebuild(made["R0"][1], made["R0"][0], f"R0-{name}"), "R1": rebuild(no, r1_ins, f"R1-{name}"),
            "R2": rebuild(made["R2"][1], made["R2"][0], f"R2-{name}"), "R3": rebuild(no, r3_ins, f"R3-{name}"),
            "E0": rebuild(made["R0"][1], e0_ins, f"E0-{name}"), "E1": rebuild(no, e1_ins, f"E1-{name}"),
            "Z": rebuild(made["Z"][1], made["Z"][0], f"Z-{name}")}
    return circ, {"T_M": w_no, "check3": check3, "echo_x": {"E0": e0_x, "E1": e1_x}, "tl_no": tl_no}


def x_on(c, q):
    return sum(1 for i in c.data if i.operation.name == "x" and c.find_bit(i.qubits[0]).index == q)


def checks(name, chain, circ, info, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    T = info["T_M"]["T_dt"]
    rec = {}
    tls = {}
    for k, c in circ.items():
        ins, _ = schedule(c, backend, chain)
        tl = timed(ins, t, dt, chain)
        tls[k] = tl
        ops = {a: int(b) for a, b in c.count_ops().items()}
        init = list(c.layout.initial_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True))
        p = W.exact_distribution(c)
        r = {"count_ops": ops, "no_swap": ops.get("swap", 0) == 0, "layout_as_named": init == chain,
             "non_delay_ops_only_on_chain": {c.find_bit(q).index for i in c.data if i.operation.name != "delay" for q in i.qubits} <= set(chain)}
        if k.startswith("W"):
            r["exact_F"] = W.fidelity(p, ideal)
            r["exact_F_1"] = abs(r["exact_F"] - 1) < 1e-6
            r["structure_5cz_6meas_3reset"] = ops.get("cz") == 5 and ops.get("measure") == 6 and ops.get("reset") == 3
        else:
            r["exact_P1_M"] = sum(v for key, v in p.items() if key[0] == "1")
            r["M_reads_0"] = r["exact_P1_M"] < 1e-9
            if k != "Z":
                w = window(tl, M)
                r["M_window"] = w
                r["window_is_T_M"] = w["T_dt"] == T and w["n_sx"] == 2
            else:
                r["M_window"] = window(tl, M)
                r["zero_wait"] = r["M_window"]["T_dt"] == 0
            m_between = [nm for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if M in qs and r["M_window"]["start_dt"] <= s < r["M_window"]["end_dt"] and nm not in ("rz",)]
            r["M_ops_in_window"] = sorted(set(m_between))
            r["M_window_ops_ok"] = set(m_between) <= ({"delay", "barrier", "x"} if k.startswith("E") else {"delay", "barrier"}) and (m_between.count("x") == (1 if k.startswith("E") else 0))
        if k == "W-ref":
            r["pulses_on_M"] = x_on(c, M) > x_on(circ["W-no"], M)
        rec[k] = r
    # check 2: in R1 and R3 every measure and reset on L1 and L3 starts and lasts as in W-no, to the dt
    tab = {str(q): {"W-no": events(info["tl_no"], q), "R1": events(tls["R1"], q), "R3": events(tls["R3"], q), "E1": events(tls["E1"], q)} for q in (L1, L3)}
    same = all(tab[str(q)][k] == tab[str(q)]["W-no"] for q in (L1, L3) for k in ("R1", "R3", "E1"))
    # R1's neighbours: every operation other than a delay or barrier at the same start and length as in W-no, the CZs
    # with M gone (they are idle time now; re-scheduling may join adjacent delays, which changes no start time)
    keep = lambda tl, q: [(nm, s, d) for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if q in qs and nm not in ("barrier", "delay", "cz")]
    r1_same = all(keep(info["tl_no"], q) == keep(tls["R1"], q) for q in (L1, L3))
    m_r2 = window(tls["R2"], M)
    x_r2 = [(s, d) for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tls["R2"] if nm == "x" and qs[0] in (L1, L3)]
    rec["_neighbours"] = {"measure_reset_times": tab, "R1_R3_E1_same_as_W_no": same, "R1_neighbour_timeline_same_as_W_no": r1_same,
                          "R2_x_before_M_first_H": all(s + d <= m_r2["start_dt"] for s, d in x_r2) and len(x_r2) == 2,
                          "R3_neighbours_only_measure_reset_delay_barrier": all(nm in ("measure", "reset", "delay", "barrier") for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tls["R3"] if qs == [L1] or qs == [L3])}
    rec["_check3"] = info["check3"]
    rec["_echo_x"] = info["echo_x"]
    ok = (all(all(v for kk, v in r.items() if isinstance(v, bool)) for kk_, r in rec.items() if not kk_.startswith("_"))
          and same and r1_same and rec["_neighbours"]["R2_x_before_M_first_H"] and rec["_neighbours"]["R3_neighbours_only_measure_reset_delay_barrier"]
          and info["check3"]["cz_only"])
    return rec, ok


def build(backend):
    circ, recs, infos, ok = {}, {}, {}, True
    for name, chain in CHAINS.items():
        c, info = build_chain(name, chain, backend)
        r, good = checks(name, chain, c, info, backend)
        ok = ok and good
        circ[name] = c
        recs[name] = r
        infos[name] = {"T_M": info["T_M"], "check3": info["check3"], "echo_x": info["echo_x"]}
    return circ, recs, infos, ok


def assemble(circ, seed=SEEDS["order"]):
    items = [(n, k, cp) for n in CHAINS for k in CIRCUITS for cp in range(1, COPIES + 1)]
    perm = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(len(items))
    circs, labels = [], []
    for i in perm:
        n, k, cp = items[i]
        lab = {"M": int(n), "chain": CHAINS[n], "circuit": k, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": M_CLBIT}
        if k.startswith("W"):
            lab.update({"part": "W", "variant": "no" if k == "W-no" else "refocus"})
        else:
            lab["part"] = "R"
        circs.append(circ[n][k])
        labels.append(lab)
    return circs, labels, [SHOTS] * len(circs)

"""Kickoff 50 analysis, fixed before the data (section 3 of the kickoff; k50-rule.md).

Per M (144, then 143), from the counts of the 36 circuits:
- The wait test: F_no and F_ref, the squared Hellinger overlap with the exact ideal, pooled over the two copies, by the
  package's analysis (manacitra.wait.analyse_wait_run, as the repository's Kickoff 48 recompute uses it), the outcome
  keys in the recompute's order (tests/_reuse_runs.py, _wait_test_keys).
- M's P(1) in R0, R1, R2, R3, E0, E1 and Z from M's own bit (c5), pooled over the two copies; loss = P(1) - P(1) of Z.
- Delta_active = loss(R0) - loss(R1); d0 = F_no - F_ref (1 - loss(R0)); d1 = F_no - F_ref (1 - loss(R1)); beside:
  loss(R0) - loss(R2), loss(R0) - loss(R3), the echo losses.
- 90% intervals (5th and 95th percentiles) from one joint bootstrap, seed 50, 10,000 draws, in a fixed order: M by M;
  F_no then F_ref (Kickoffs 45 to 49's draw: the copies with replacement, each redrawn from a multinomial); then Z,
  R0, R1, R2, R3, E0, E1 (Kickoff 48's draw for a qubit's P(1): the copies with replacement, each redrawn binomially).

The verdict (H50, on 144): the gap is REPRODUCED if 144's d0 interval lies entirely above +0.10; otherwise the verdict
carries "(Kickoff 49's gap not present today)". SUPPORTED if Delta_active's interval lies entirely above +0.10; OPPOSITE
if entirely below -0.10; NOT SUPPORTED if entirely inside [-0.05, +0.05]; NOT SETTLED otherwise.
Beside, not used: Delta_active on 143; d1 on both, against +-0.15; the state and readout split; the echo losses; the
calibration stamps beside Kickoff 49's.

Usage: python analyse_50.py                 (Kickoff 50's files)
       python analyse_50.py --synthetic     (counts drawn from stated distributions, to exercise the code before data)"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "site"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "src-a55354d" / "tests"))
from manacitra import wait as W  # noqa: E402
import _reuse_runs as reuse  # noqa: E402

ORDER_M = ("144", "143")
RAMSEY = ("Z", "R0", "R1", "R2", "R3", "E0", "E1")
SEED, N_BOOT = 50, 10_000
REPRODUCED_FLOOR, SUPPORTED, BAND, D1_MARGIN = 0.10, 0.10, 0.05, 0.15
CAL_K49_UTC = datetime(2026, 10, 13, 16, 8, 33, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
K49_144 = {"F_no": 0.786, "F_ref": 0.896, "dP_R_TM": 0.326, "d_M": 0.182}


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def pct(a):
    return reuse.pct(a)


def analyse(labels, counts, dt):
    keys, q = reuse._wait_test_keys()

    def F(V):
        return np.sqrt(V / V.sum(-1, keepdims=True) * q).sum(-1) ** 2

    cells, bits = defaultdict(list), defaultdict(list)
    for lab, cts in zip(labels, counts):
        M = str(lab["M"])
        if lab["part"] == "W":
            d = defaultdict(int)
            for k, n in cts.items():
                d[k.replace(" ", "")[-W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS:]] += n
            cells[(M, lab["variant"])].append((lab["copy"], [d.get(k, 0) for k in keys]))
        else:
            i = lab["m_clbit"]
            ones = sum(n for k, n in cts.items() if k.replace(" ", "")[::-1][i] == "1")
            bits[(M, lab["circuit"])].append((lab["copy"], ones, sum(cts.values())))
    for d in (cells, bits):
        for k in d:
            d[k].sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

    def draw_F(M, v):
        V = np.array([x[1] for x in cells[(M, v)]], float)
        freq = V / V.sum(1, keepdims=True)
        idx = rng.integers(0, V.shape[0], size=(N_BOOT, V.shape[0]))
        return F(rng.multinomial(int(V[0].sum()), freq[idx]).sum(1))

    def draw_P(M, c):
        o = np.array([x[1] for x in bits[(M, c)]])
        t = np.array([x[2] for x in bits[(M, c)]])
        acc1, accn = np.zeros(N_BOOT), np.zeros(N_BOOT)
        for _ in range(len(o)):
            pick = rng.integers(0, len(o), size=N_BOOT)
            acc1 += rng.binomial(t[pick], o[pick] / t[pick])
            accn += t[pick]
        return acc1 / accn

    out = {}
    for M in ORDER_M:
        mine = [(lab, cts) for lab, cts in zip(labels, counts) if str(lab["M"]) == M and lab["part"] == "W"]
        wt = W.analyse_wait_run([lab for lab, _ in mine], [c for _, c in mine], dt)["wait_test"]
        Fb = {"no": draw_F(M, "no"), "refocus": draw_F(M, "refocus")}
        Pb = {c: draw_P(M, c) for c in RAMSEY}
        P = {c: sum(x[1] for x in bits[(M, c)]) / sum(x[2] for x in bits[(M, c)]) for c in RAMSEY}
        loss = {c: P[c] - P["Z"] for c in RAMSEY if c != "Z"}
        loss_b = {c: Pb[c] - Pb["Z"] for c in RAMSEY if c != "Z"}
        f_no, f_ref = wt["F_no"], wt["F_refocus"]
        q_ = {
            "F_no": f_no, "F_no_ci90": pct(Fb["no"]), "F_ref": f_ref, "F_ref_ci90": pct(Fb["refocus"]),
            "F_per_copy": wt["F_per_copy"],
            "P1": P, "P1_ci90": {c: pct(Pb[c]) for c in RAMSEY},
            "shots": {c: [x[2] for x in bits[(M, c)]] for c in RAMSEY},
            "loss": loss, "loss_ci90": {c: pct(v) for c, v in loss_b.items()},
            "delta_active": loss["R0"] - loss["R1"], "delta_active_ci90": pct(loss_b["R0"] - loss_b["R1"]),
            "d0": f_no - f_ref * (1 - loss["R0"]), "d0_ci90": pct(Fb["no"] - Fb["refocus"] * (1 - loss_b["R0"])),
            "d1": f_no - f_ref * (1 - loss["R1"]), "d1_ci90": pct(Fb["no"] - Fb["refocus"] * (1 - loss_b["R1"])),
            "state_split_R0_minus_R2": loss["R0"] - loss["R2"], "state_split_ci90": pct(loss_b["R0"] - loss_b["R2"]),
            "readout_split_R0_minus_R3": loss["R0"] - loss["R3"], "readout_split_ci90": pct(loss_b["R0"] - loss_b["R3"]),
            "echo_active_E0_minus_E1": loss["E0"] - loss["E1"], "echo_active_ci90": pct(loss_b["E0"] - loss_b["E1"]),
        }
        lo, hi = q_["d1_ci90"]
        q_["d1_vs_0p15"] = "inside" if (lo > -D1_MARGIN and hi < D1_MARGIN) else ("outside" if (lo > D1_MARGIN or hi < -D1_MARGIN) else "neither")
        out[M] = q_

    m = out["144"]
    reproduced = m["d0_ci90"][0] > REPRODUCED_FLOOR
    lo, hi = m["delta_active_ci90"]
    if lo > SUPPORTED:
        h50 = "SUPPORTED"
    elif hi < -SUPPORTED:
        h50 = "OPPOSITE"
    elif lo > -BAND and hi < BAND:
        h50 = "NOT SUPPORTED"
    else:
        h50 = "NOT SETTLED"
    verdict = f"{h50}, REPRODUCED" if reproduced else f"{h50} (Kickoff 49's gap not present today)"
    return {"verdict": verdict, "H50": h50, "reproduced": reproduced, "per_M": out}


def synthetic():
    """Counts drawn from stated distributions through the same code: case 1, no loss anywhere (expect NOT SUPPORTED, gap
    not present); case 2, 144 with loss(R0) 0.33 and loss(R1) 0.13, F_no 0.79, F_ref 0.90 (expect SUPPORTED, REPRODUCED)."""
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    keys = sorted(ideal)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)

    def w_counts(f):
        # F = (sum sqrt(p q))^2 with q uniform over the 32 ideal keys: put mass a on them and 1 - a on one other key
        a = f
        p = {k: a / 32 for k in keys}
        p["111111" if "111111" not in ideal else "000001"] = 1 - a
        ks = list(p)
        n = rng.multinomial(5000, [p[k] for k in ks])
        return {k: int(v) for k, v in zip(ks, n) if v}

    def r_counts(p1):
        o = int(rng.binomial(5000, p1))
        return {"000000": 5000 - o, "100000": o}

    out = []
    for case, spec in ((1, {"144": (1.0, 1.0, {})}), (2, {"144": (0.79, 0.90, {"R0": 0.33, "R1": 0.13, "R2": 0.30, "R3": 0.25, "E0": 0.03, "E1": 0.03})})):
        labels, counts = [], []
        for M in ORDER_M:
            fno, fref, losses = spec.get(M, (1.0, 1.0, {}))
            for cp in (1, 2):
                for v, f in (("no", fno), ("refocus", fref)):
                    labels.append({"M": int(M), "part": "W", "variant": v, "copy": cp, "circuit": "W-" + ("no" if v == "no" else "ref")})
                    counts.append(w_counts(f))
                for c in RAMSEY:
                    labels.append({"M": int(M), "part": "R", "circuit": c, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5})
                    counts.append(r_counts(0.01 + losses.get(c, 0.0)))
        r = analyse(labels, counts, 4e-9)
        m = r["per_M"]["144"]
        out.append((case, r["verdict"], round(m["d0"], 3), [round(x, 3) for x in m["d0_ci90"]], round(m["delta_active"], 3), [round(x, 3) for x in m["delta_active_ci90"]]))
    for o in out:
        print("synthetic case", *o)
